item.title: Gurgaon hit-and-run: Car driver arrested, attempt-to-murder charge added after CCTV probe
item.description: In a significant turn of events, Gurgaon Police have apprehended a car driver, intensifying charges against him with an attempt-to-murder offense. This decision came after thorough examination of CCTV footage that captured the alarming incident, which had sparked viral outrage on social media. Investigators have also invoked Section 109 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita in the FIR, while police caution against vigilante justice.
item.dc:creator: NIKHIL SHARMA

item.title: Mohsin Naqvi to take drastic steps as Aaqib Javed, Wahab Riaz face axe
item.description: After a poor performance in England, Pakistan cricket is gearing up for a possible major shake-up. Reports indicate that the Pakistan Cricket Board is evaluating the national selection committee, with former player Aaqib Javed at risk of losing his position. Furthermore, the changes may extend to the women's team and coaching personnel, as Mohsin Naqvi confers with his team and board members to finalize the direction ahead.
item.dc:creator: PRANAV SHUKLA

item.title: Anthropic CEO responds to ex-employee who resigned 'warning' that AI could kill all
item.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei agrees with Jacob Coxon's concerns about AI development speed. Coxon warned that the AI industry could cause catastrophic harm by the decade's end. Amodei clarified Coxon was not criticizing Anthropic but the broader industry dynamic. He now avoids giving a single AI extinction probability figure. Amodei emphasizes choosing the right development paths for AI safety.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Gold price prediction today: Will bearish bias continue? Check outlook
item.description: Gold remains under corrective pressure after the sharp rejection from the recent Rs 164,000–166,000 zone, with prices currently trading near Rs 151,000.
item.dc:creator: SMRITI JAIN

item.title: Does India still need Russia’s S-500? How its own missile shield is changing the equation
item.description: India's recent missile defence trials demonstrate significant advancements in its capabilities. These tests validated the nation's ability to intercept various aerial threats effectively. Russia's S-500 Prometheus system offers advanced capabilities against ballistic missiles. India is developing its own Ballistic Missile Defence apparatus to counter modern threats. This progress places India among nations with advanced missile defence systems.
item.dc:creator: DHRUV YADAV

item.title: ‘I pity Samson’: Ex-cricketer slams Gambhir and management over Sooryavanshi
item.description: Kris Srikkanth questioned why Vaibhav Sooryavanshi was left out of India's T20 opening match. He emphasized Sooryavanshi's remarkable performance against Zimbabwe, where he was named Player of the Series, and criticized the team management for not giving him a fair opportunity. Furthermore, Srikkanth expressed concern over the inconsistent selection of Sanju Samson and called for more transparent selection policies for both players.
item.dc:creator: PRANAV SHUKLA

item.title: Real estate businessman lost Rs 34.21 lakh in F&O, got I-T notice: What ITAT ruled
item.description: The AO invoked the Explanation to Section 73 and consequently refused to allow the loss to be set off against the taxpayer’s regular business income. The assessment relied on the Delhi High Court ruling in CIT v. DLF Commercial Developers Ltd.
item.dc:creator: TOI BUSINESS DESK

item.title: 'Mirzapur The Movie' BO Day 12 [LIVE]: Pankaj Tripathi film targets Rs 200 crore
item.description: The Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal and Divyenndu-led crime drama, 'Mirzapur The Movie' continues its theatrical journey with the crime franchise’s big-screen adaptation maintaining a strong cumulative total at the domestic box office on Day 12. With the film now approaching the Rs. 200 crore India net mark, the next few days could determine whether it manages to achieve the milestone. The film’s worldwide earnings have also received support from overseas markets, taking its global gross closer to the Rs. 275 crore mark.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: Athens is turning old airport into Europe’s second-largest city park
item.description: Athens is set to unveil Ellinikon Park, a visionary urban greening initiative built on a repurposed airport lot. This expansive project seeks to offer city dwellers a refreshing escape with lush greenery and water features designed to effectively reduce temperatures. By incorporating recycled materials and native flora, the park aims to lessen its ecological footprint. The grand opening for this much-anticipated oasis is planned for next year.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Bel-Air founder’s 1928 mansion bought for $5.5m now asks $32.5 million
item.description: A 1928 mansion built for Alphonzo Bell, the oil businessman who helped create Bel-Air, is now listed for $32.5 million. Michael Wexler bought the Los Angeles home for $5.5 million in 2010 and spent years restoring it. The 10,600-square-foot property now has seven bedrooms, a theatre, pool, wine cellar and 26 newly planted redwood sequoias.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: Apple rolls out iOS 27: 10 ways it will 'change' your iPhone
item.description: Apple has released iOS 27, its biggest iPhone software update of 2026, free for every iPhone 11 and newer. Siri AI now searches your mail, messages and photos, Visual Intelligence moves into the Camera app, Shortcuts builds automations from one sentence, parental controls get stronger and older iPhones run faster. Here are 10 iOS 27 features to try first, plus the compatible iPhones and how to update.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Russian businessman funded Trump Jr’s Bahamas wedding after-party
item.description: Umar Kremlev, a Russian businessman with connections to Vladimir Putin, funded the lavish after-party for Donald Trump Jr's wedding. Both Trump Jr and his partner Bettina Anderson took to Instagram to acknowledge Kremlev's extravagant generosity. ProPublica revealed that Kremlev spent hundreds of thousands on the festive weekend, though the couple clarified there’s no political motivation behind their friendship.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: Nickhil Jakatdar explains daily protein needs and why muscle health matters as we age
item.description: Health expert Nickhil Jakatdar highlights the essential function of protein that extends beyond simply building muscles. He recommends that adults incorporate 1.2 to 1.6 grams of protein per kilogram of body weight into their diets. This intake is crucial for maintaining muscle health and ensuring daily independence. Structured meal plans can help achieve an approximate daily intake of 100 grams, which is vital for sustained well-being.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: Scotland, Northern Ireland and Wales sign historic MoU to break away from UK
item.description: Leaders from Scotland, Northern Ireland, and Wales signed a pact seeking independence. This historic agreement signals a shift away from Westminster's long-standing control. The first ministers are committed to self-determination for their respective nations. They also aim to strengthen cooperation on economic and energy matters. This pact reflects a growing desire for constitutional change across these regions.
item.dc:creator: NAOMI CANTON

item.title: ‘Drunk men made offensive gestures’: Gurgaon biker’s brother
item.description: A woman's family will file a police complaint after her two-wheeler was hit by a car. The family alleges four drunk individuals were inside the vehicle which caused her distress. Gurgaon Police registered an FIR after taking suo motu cognisance of the incident. The victim's brother stated she was chased and subjected to offensive gestures. The woman is experiencing trauma after the hit-and-run incident on Golf Course Road.
item.dc:creator: LAIRENLAKPAM WARLI

item.title: 'Tareekh Pe Tareekh': 100% complete, still no keys; Inside RERA’s extension loop
item.description: A growing number of housing developments are running past their scheduled completion dates, leading to frequent regulatory extensions that lack a guarantee of timely delivery. MahaRERA's data highlights a substantial volume of these extensions processed annually. Developers often tout impressive completion figures while still pending crucial approvals. The oversight framework fails to secure buyer possession effectively, raising concerns about the effectiveness of the system.
item.dc:creator: ARGHYA PRASUN ROYCHOWDHURY

item.title: ‘Would a minister have escaped it?’ Top lawyers call for reset after judge cash row
item.description: Leading lawyers called for judicial reform and increased transparency in the system. They questioned the lack of an FIR after cash was found at a judge's residence. Chief Justice Surya Kant defended the judiciary's internal complaint redressal mechanism. He stated that most complaints arise from disgruntled litigants after court reversals. Lawyers also criticized the opaqueness in judicial appointments and transfers.
item.dc:creator: DHANANJAY MAHAPATRA

item.title: Tamil Nadu shop owner arrested over banner showing Lord Ganesha eating biryani
item.description: Tirunelveli police arrested a biryani shop owner on Saturday. The owner allegedly displayed a banner showing Lord Ganesha eating biryani. A complainant alleged the banner insulted Hindu religious sentiments. Police initiated an inquiry and made the arrest under relevant law. The shop owner was taken into custody following the complaint.
item.dc:creator: AHAMED ALI

item.title: Mystery missile in Yemen: Did Saudi Arabia use China-made DF-15A?
item.description: Debris believed to be a Chinese-made DF-15A ballistic missile booster was found in Yemen. Open-source analysts identified the component and attributed it to Saudi Arabia's military. This discovery occurs amid intensified fighting and increased missile attacks in the region. The DF-15A is a solid-fuelled short-range ballistic missile with a significant range. Saudi Arabia has not officially confirmed operating this specific Chinese missile system.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: Cases against 3 DMK leaders over remarks against TN CM Vijay's speech
item.description: In a significant move, Chennai and Kallakurichi police have initiated legal proceedings against three DMK leaders following protest remarks made on September twelfth. Notably, former minister P K Sekarbabu has been charged in Chennai for his contentious protest speech, while DMK MP A Raja faces allegations for derogatory comments aimed at a state minister. Additional cases have also emerged in Kallakurichi and Cuddalore, all linked to the same protests.
item.dc:creator: A SELVARAJ

item.title: 'I could've died': Gurgaon biker rebuts driver's 'accident' defence in new video
item.description: Woman biker Sia shared a video statement refuting claims of an accidental collision. She stated the footage showed the car chasing bikers before the incident occurred. The accused driver denied deliberately hitting Sia and claimed the videos were edited. Gurgaon Police registered an FIR and are investigating the viral footage further. The incident highlights concerns about road safety for women in the region.
item.dc:creator: VRITI JAIN

item.title: Temple care is matter of duty for me, not publicity: Ram Mandir CEO Jeetendra Mishra
item.description: Jeetendra Mishra, the newly appointed CEO, passionately defended his extensive experience in temple administration, highlighting his management of over fifty religious sites throughout his Air Force career. He emphasized that caring for temples is not just a responsibility but a profound duty. Mishra also shared his memorable visits to prominent pilgrimage centers across India, underscoring his commitment to this spiritual role.
item.dc:creator: ARVIND CHAUHAN

item.title: From Bahrain to Riyadh: How Iran strikes battered US bases, embassies
item.description: A recent Pentagon report highlights the extensive destruction of US military and diplomatic infrastructures due to Iranian strikes. Hundreds of buildings sustained damage across the Middle East, creating severe logistical hurdles and personnel displacements for American forces. The Iranian onslaught resulted in an estimated $184 million in damages to diplomatic establishments, escalating the conflict that ignited on February 28 in response to US and Israeli military actions.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: 'He said stop bike': Gurgaon woman biker recounts moments before car hit her
item.description: A young woman fell from her superbike after a car allegedly cut her path. She narrowly escaped being run over by fast-moving traffic on Golf Course Road. Action camera footage captured the incident and its immediate aftermath. The driver of the Maruti Ciaz offered a different account of the events. The woman later shared the footage on social media platforms.
